test_title: SSC CGL (2022) Tier-II Official Paper (Held On : 3 March 2023)
subject: general
question: In India, which of the following is NOT an objective of the National Manufacturing Policy?

options.text: To increase the sectoral share of manufacturing in GDP to at least 25% by 2022.
To double the exports of manufacturing goods by 2022.
To increase the rate of job creation so as to create 100 million additional jobs by 2022
To enhance global competitiveness, domestic value addition, technological depth and environmental sustainability of growth.

solution:
Correct Answer **To double the exports of manufacturing goods by 2022.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points:__**

 
• The policy aims to increase the share of manufacturing in the country’s GDP to 25% by 2022.
 
• The National Manufacturing Policy aims to create 100 million additional jobs in the next decade.
 
• The draft policy envisages the establishment of National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZ) equipped with world-class infrastructure.
 
• Each National Investment and Manufacturing Zones will have 5,000 hectares.
 
• The Department of Industrial Policy and Promotion (DIPP) under The Ministry of Commerce and Industry has notified the National Manufacturing Policy (NMP) on November 4, 2011. 
 
• The National Manufacturing Policy provides a major impetus for economic growth and development.
